name: zvideo_dd_get_hw_api_device_feature_flags
description: zVideo_dd::GetHwApiDeviceFeatureFlags returns the selected DirectDraw hardware API device record's feature flags by table index.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw device-table/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9920 validates a leaf fastcall helper that computes the 0x6ec-byte zVidHwApiDeviceRecordPartial stride from ECX and returns g_zVideo_HwApiDeviceTable[deviceIndex].m_deviceFeatureFlags at 0x633ee8.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a9920 has no warnings and matches the implemented table-indexed feature flag load.

The native smoke verifies direct calls read distinct feature flag values from multiple device table entries and verifies g_zVideo_pfnGetHwApiDeviceFeatureFlags can dispatch to the authored symbol. The bind-dispatch smoke verifies BindRendererDispatch installs the authored function pointer.
